starting-out-before-starting-eagle-s-pea.speaker: Charlie
starting-out-before-starting-eagle-s-pea.text: Yes, er, welcome to the zoo! I'm afraid I'm kind of busy right now; what was it you wanted?

options.text: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!

steps.player: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!

steps.text: If the player is below level 27 in Hunter:

steps.speaker: Charlie
steps.text: Well... maybe. How much do you know about hunting?

steps.player: Well I know a little bit...

steps.speaker: Charlie
steps.text: No, I could do with some help, but I'm afraid I need somebody with a little more experience.
If the player is level 27 or above in Hunter:

steps.speaker: Charlie
steps.text: Actually, now that you come to mention it, you might be able to help me.

steps.speaker: Charlie
steps.text: A few weeks ago we had a delivery of a northern ferret. They're funny little creatures. Turns out they're tricksy little blighters too.

steps.speaker: Charlie
steps.text: Whilst we were unloading him from the cart he managed to escape his cage. What's more he gave the driver a nasty nip on the way out too.

steps.speaker: Charlie
steps.text: This was obviously a bit of a blow, you can't make a new attraction without any animals.

steps.speaker: Charlie
steps.text: We got in contact with one of our associates, a huntsman called Nickolaus, who agreed to capture us another.

steps.speaker: Charlie
steps.text: Funny thing is we haven't heard from him for some time now. I don't suppose you'd mind having a look for him?

options.text: Sure.  Any idea where I should start looking?

steps.player: Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?

steps.speaker: Charlie
steps.text: Well the northern ferret is mostly found around the mountains just west of the Gnome Stronghold, so that would probably be as good a place as any to start looking.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

options.text: Sorry, I don't have the time.

steps.player: Sorry, I don't have the time.

steps.speaker: Charlie
steps.text: Oh well, I'm sure he'll be okay out there on his own.

options.text: Where did you get the animals from?

starting-out-talking-to-charlie-again.speaker: Charlie
starting-out-talking-to-charlie-again.text: Ah, hello again. Have you had any luck finding out about Nickolaus' whereabouts yet?

starting-out-talking-to-charlie-again.speaker: Charlie
starting-out-talking-to-charlie-again.text: Like I said, he's most likely to be camping out somewhere to the west of the Gnome Stronghold.

nickolaus-s-camp-interacting-with-the-ca.text: A few logs are still burning so it can't have been unattended long.

nickolaus-s-camp-picking-up-the-bird-boo.text: Amongst the scattered books one in particular grabs your attention; there seems to be something poking out from between the pages.

nickolaus-s-camp-opening-the-bird-book.text: As you open the book something falls out from between the pages. It appears to be a small metal feather.

nickolaus-s-camp-reclaiming-a-lost-feath.text: Amongst the scattered books you find a small metal feather.

nickolaus-s-camp-interacting-with-the-bo.text: These books look like they've been kicked over by someone or something.

nickolaus-s-camp-interacting-with-the-ro.text: This area of rock doesn't quite seem to match the rest of the cliff face. There appears to be a thin vertical slot in the middle of the rock, with what appears to be a carving of a feather above it.

nickolaus-s-camp-using-the-metal-feather.text: You place the metal feather into the groove in the cliff face. It seems to catch in some sort of mechanism.
Part of the cliff face swings outwards to reveal a tunnel heading into the mountain.
The cliff face has already opened to reveal a tunnel heading into the mountain.

nickolaus-s-camp-approaching-nickolaus-a.speaker: Nickolaus
nickolaus-s-camp-approaching-nickolaus-a.text: Aha, I see my reputation precedes me. Yes, I am the renowned hunter and explorer Nickolaus. You've arrived just in time to witness a very momentous occasion, for I have just discovered the nest of a giant

nickolaus-s-camp-approaching-nickolaus-a.speaker: Nickolaus
nickolaus-s-camp-approaching-nickolaus-a.text: eagle.  And a most amazing discovery it is too, even if I do say so myself.

options.text: The Ardougne zookeeper sent me to find you.

steps.player: The Ardougne zookeeper sent me to find you.

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: Ah yes, he sent me to find a ferret. A trivial task, and one which pales in comparison compared to this momentous discovery. I'm sure he can wait.

options.text: Well if you gave me a ferret I could take it back for you.
So it's not that you're trapped then?

steps.player: So it's not that you're trapped then?

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: Well I think trapped is quite a negative way of looking at it.

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: I will admit however that getting out of here may be a little tricky. I did have a plan, but unfortunately it didn't involve being stuck in this nest.

options.text: Could I help at all?

steps.player: Could I help at all?

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: Actually I believe you could. I need to somehow trick the eagles into thinking I'm one of them. Could you fashion some sort of disguise for me?

steps.player: What would that involve?

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: Well, you could go and speak to the fancy dress shop owner in Varrock.  He can make anything if you give him the right materials. In fact you should probably get a couple of disguises, one for each of us.

steps.player: That's a good idea. There are plenty of feathers around here. I'll see what I can do.

options.text: Well it'll give you a lot of time to study the eagles

steps.player: Well it'll give you a lot of time to study the eagles.

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: Very true, and certainly an opportunity I wouldn't want to miss.

steps.player: Well, I'll let you get on with your work then.

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: It's always a pleasure to discuss my discoveries.

options.text: Oh, but I'd come to rescue you.

steps.player: I've come to rescue you.

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: How very kind of you. But Nickolaus Farrick never needs rescuing.  I may apparently be trapped in a giant eagle's nest, but it is all a cunning ruse to put the beast at ease.

options.text: Aren't giant eagles mythical?
Oh, so you're not really trapped?

steps.player: Oh, so you're not really trapped?

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: Well I think trapped is quite a negative way of looking at it.

options.text: Aren't giant eagles mythical?

steps.player: Aren't giant eagles mythical?

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: Oh many people believe so, yes, but my relentless exploration has paid off once again, for I stand now in the nest of such a supposedly mythical creature.

steps.player: How did you manage to find the nest?

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: Through unfaltering dedication, attention to detail, oh, and I suppose there's the minor point that I got carried here by an eagle.

steps.player: So in fact the eagle found you?

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: So it might appear to an amateur yes, and, well, I may have been a little lucky, but it's still a remarkable discovery don't you think?

options.text: Amazing, but what do you intend to do now you've discovered it?

steps.player: Amazing, but what do you intend to do now you've discovered it?

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: Well, there's all sorts to do. I need to observe its behaviour patterns and document its feeding habits.  The discovery is only just the beginning you know.

options.text: I think you're trapped.

steps.player: I think you're trapped.

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: Well I think trapped is quite a negative way of looking at it.

options.text: Well, I'll let you get on with your work then.
Well, I'll let you get on with your work then.

nickolaus-s-camp-shouting-at-nickolaus.player: Hello Nickolaus, how are you getting on with your discoveries?

nickolaus-s-camp-shouting-at-nickolaus.speaker: Nickolaus
nickolaus-s-camp-shouting-at-nickolaus.text: Wonderfully, these giant eagles are simply magnificent creatures.  I absolutely must see about getting one as a pet.

options.text: The Ardougne zookeeper sent me to find you.
A pet?  Are you crazy?

steps.player: A pet?  Are you crazy?

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: Quite possibly, quite possibly, but I haven't found a creature I couldn't tame yet.

options.text: I've come to rescue you.
Aren't giant eagles mythical?

nickolaus-s-camp-visiting-nickolaus-afte.player: Hello Nickolaus, how are you getting on with your discoveries?

nickolaus-s-camp-visiting-nickolaus-afte.speaker: Nickolaus
nickolaus-s-camp-visiting-nickolaus-afte.text: Wonderfully thank you, although I am still having just a little trouble convincing them to let me leave.

nickolaus-s-camp-visiting-nickolaus-afte.speaker: Nickolaus
nickolaus-s-camp-visiting-nickolaus-afte.text: I don't suppose you've managed to get that disguise I asked for yet?

nickolaus-s-camp-visiting-nickolaus-afte.speaker: Nickolaus
nickolaus-s-camp-visiting-nickolaus-afte.text: Well like I said, the Varrock fancy dress shop is a good bet if you have the materials, and there are plenty of feathers around here.

nickolaus-s-camp-visiting-nickolaus-afte.speaker: Nickolaus
nickolaus-s-camp-visiting-nickolaus-afte.text: And while you're working on that, I'll get back to studying these incredible winged wonders.

getting-a-bird-costume.speaker: Asyff
getting-a-bird-costume.text: Now you look like someone who goes to a lot of fancy dress parties.

getting-a-bird-costume.speaker: Asyff
getting-a-bird-costume.text: I'm just saying that perhaps you would like to peruse my selection of garments.

getting-a-bird-costume.speaker: Asyff
getting-a-bird-costume.text: Or, if that doesn't interest you, then maybe you have something else to offer? I'm always on the look out for interesting or unusual new materials.

options.text: Okay, lets see what you've got then.
Well, specifically I'm after a couple of bird costumes.

steps.player: Well, specifically I'm after a couple of bird costumes.

steps.speaker: Asyff
steps.text: Ah, an inspired choice. What kind of bird were you thinking of?

steps.player: A giant eagle.

steps.speaker: Asyff
steps.text: Very interesting. Unfortunately I don't think I have any giant eagle costumes in stock at the moment.

steps.speaker: Asyff
steps.text: Of course if I had the materials I could make them for you.

steps.player: What materials would you need?

steps.speaker: Asyff
steps.text: Well, the main problem is that I'm fresh out of giant eagle feathers. I've been meaning to get onto my supplier about that for some time.

steps.player: Wait a second, you have a supplier? But I thought nobody knew where to find the nests?

steps.speaker: Asyff
steps.text: Well, there was some chap in desert clothing. He said his name was Ali. He assured me they were giant eagle feathers, although when I come to think about it they were suspiciously similar to chicken feathers.

steps.speaker: Asyff
steps.text: Anyway, you're probably looking at about 10 giant eagle feathers, assuming you can find a nest.

steps.speaker: Asyff
steps.text: I'd also need some swamp tar to hold things together and some yellow dye for the beaks.  Everything else I can supply myself.

steps.player: I'll see what I can do.

options.text: I think I might just leave the perusing for now thanks.

steps.text: There is a clear patch in the layer of dust covering the top of the pedestal. It looks like something lay here recently, but you don't have a high enough Hunter level to determine where it may have gone.

steps.text: There is a clear patch in the layer of dust covering the top of the pedestal. It looks like something lay here recently. Around the base of the pedestal you spy what appear to be faint footprints leading away from the area.

bringing-over-the-outfit-to-nickolaus-si.text: There is a clear patch in the layer of dust covering the top of the pedestal. It looks like something lay here recently, but you can't find any further clues as to where it may have gone.
Closer inspection reveals the rocks to be hard, grey and generally just rock-like.
These rocks appear to have shifted recently. Further inspection reveals faint tracks among the debris, although they aren't tracks you recognise.
Apart from the unusual tracks you found earlier, there is little else to find amongst these rocks.
After carefully examining the rocks, you manage to pick up the mysterious trail again. The tracks aren't entirely unfamiliar, but they do seem somewhat larger than any you have seen before.
You peer down the tunnel for signs of the mysterious creature.
A giant Kebbit jumps out of the cave.

options.text: Taunt the kebbit.

steps.player: Give me that or... Er...
Your mother was a hamster, and your father smelt of elderberries!

steps.text: The Kebbit goes into the opening while dropping the Silver feather.

options.text: Try something else.

bringing-over-the-outfit-to-nickolaus-si.text: This tunnel seems to get thinner quite quickly. I doubt a human could fit down it.
Upon closer inspection you find a small silver feather at the entrance to the tunnel.

bringing-over-the-outfit-to-nickolaus-go.text: You take a handful of the birdseed-like substance from the holder.
Putting feed into this feeder seems to have no effect.
As you move the lever you hear a low grinding elsewhere in the caves.
As you reach for the lever, you notice the word 'reset' engraved into the handle in large angular letters.

bringing-over-the-outfit-to-nickolaus-go.prompt: Are you sure you wish to pull this lever?

options.text: Yes, pull the reset lever.

steps.text: If there is nothing to reset:

options.text: On second thoughts, not just yet.

bringing-over-the-outfit-to-nickolaus-go.text: I already have a golden feather like that.

bringing-over-the-outfit-to-nickolaus-in.text: The door seems to be locked in place. There is an engraving of an eagle on the door. Three of the feathers illustrated in the engraving seem to be cut deeper than the others. It looks like they may once have contained some sort of decoration.
Unfortunately this metal feather doesn't seem to match any of the indentations in the engraving.

There doesn't seem to be any way of attaching this feather to the engraving. The indentations look like they probably contained some sort of decoration rather than real feathers, although there is no sign of their whereabouts now.
You insert the metallic feather into one of the feather-shaped indentations in the engravings.
As you insert the metallic feather into the final indentation you hear a low grinding as if stone blocks were moving against one another.
The engraving is already complete. There is nowhere left to put this feather.

saving-nickolaus-talking-to-nickolaus-by.speaker: Nickolaus
saving-nickolaus-talking-to-nickolaus-by.text: Ah, hello again.  Can I help at all?

options.text: Well I was originally sent to find you because of a ferret.

steps.player: Well I was originally sent to find you because of a ferret.  Can you get me one at all?

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
steps.text: I'll do better than that.  I'll teach you how to capture one yourself.

options.text: That sounds good to me.

steps.player: That sounds good to me.  What do I do.

steps.speaker: Nickolaus

steps.speaker: Nickolaus
